pin.title: JO&JOE Vienna Opens
pin.description: A social hotel-hostel beside Vienna’s Westbahnhof, offering private rooms, shared dorms, a rooftop terrace and a bar-and-events atmosphere.
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Accor’s launch release hosted by its Austrian PR agency explicitly states that JO&JOE Vienna opened on 26 August 2021 on the fifth and sixth floors of the Hus building. The later September press coverage is not substituted for the actual opening.

pin.longFormSummary:
A social hotel-hostel beside Vienna’s Westbahnhof, offering private rooms, shared dorms, a rooftop terrace and a bar-and-events atmosphere.

Budget city stay

Choose between a private room and an individual bed in a shared dorm; compare the price of the booking product you actually need. The current official page lists private and atypical rooms for up to three guests and shared dormitories for up to twelve. Confirm the exact room, bathroom, linen and towel conditions.

The Westbahnhof location offers public-transport connections for exploring Vienna. The bar, events and rooftop are part of the social setting. Check event schedules and room location if quiet sleep is a priority, and read recent reviews about bedding and dorm cleanliness.

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot has 58 reviews and a published Sleep Quality component of 2.9/5. A July 2026 guest praised the common areas but criticised dorm housekeeping. Check current shared food-preparation equipment before relying on a full kitchen.

Opening

The operator’s launch release confirms opening on 26 August 2021, with 345 beds in the hotel-hostel. The accommodation sits above the IKEA store in the same building; no whole-building investment is assigned as the hotel cost.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK snapshot, 58 reviews, Rooms 3.7, Service 4.0, Location 4.7, Cleanliness 3.8, Value 3.7 out of five, nearest-half rounding. Published Sleep Quality 2.9 is retained in the article, not relabelled as another axis. Counts are snapshots rather than live totals. Sami M’s English firsthand dorm review is displayed July 2026 without a precise publication day; date null. MICHELIN Vienna full 35-hotel list and Forbes Vienna directory read, no JO&JOE match; acclaim 0 for these checked guide selections. AAA geographic program excludes Austria.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family water-park resort on the north side of Colorado Springs, with all-suite accommodation, an indoor water park and additional dry-land activities.

Family water-park stay

The operator describes a 50,000-square-foot indoor water park and standard, themed and larger premium suites. Choose the precise suite and occupancy for your household. Check water-park access, opening hours, height requirements and any activity restrictions for your booking.

The property is at 9494 Federal Drive in northern Colorado Springs. Allow transport time for outings elsewhere in the region. Compare the complete stay cost, including taxes, parking, meals, paid activities and any optional packages.

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot gives Value 3.5/5. Read recent comments about rooms, service and extras, and confirm what the selected room booking includes rather than assuming every activity is covered.

Opening and investment

Contemporaneous reporting states that the resort opened to guests on 16 December 2016; the later January 2017 ribbon-cutting was a separate event. The launch report describes 311 suites and about US$100 million invested, including acquisition of the unfinished hotel, completion, amenities and the water park. This reported combined project investment is not a nightly rate or a construction-only subtotal.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK opened snapshot, 3,189 reviews, Rooms 4.2, Service 4.3, Location 4.5, Cleanliness 4.5, Value 3.5 out of five, nearest-half rounding. Count is a snapshot rather than a live total. Selvia priska W’s firsthand family review displayed November 2026, precise publication day unavailable, date null. MICHELIN Colorado Springs full five-hotel directory and Forbes destination list read, no Great Wolf match. Visit Colorado Springs lists AAA 3 Diamond and a Forbes 3 Star field, but a current AAA primary property record was not verified and the Forbes field is not corroborated by Forbes Travel Guide. Acclaim null pending primary verification; neither secondary field is promoted to a confirmed guide award.
